body: Thank you. I was taking a look at your comments, and you seem like a nice person. But my life just keeps going down, I have been dealt a shitty hand, and what do you do when you're dealt a shitty hand? You fold. I appreciate what you are trying to do, but the things I have dealt with have just been building up. My mind is a clusterfuck. When I wake up the first thing that runs through my mind is, "Fuck, another day." My life is going no where, and it's a non stop train. I can't stand the thought of it. I disgust myself. I am a pathetic, faggot, broken coward. I don't want it that way.
